title: A Leaky Ceiling and a Helpful Neighbor
instructions: 这是为中文成人学习者编写的原创英语听力练习（A2，第10周），主题为“住所与生活环境”。场景为模拟教育材料：李伟向房东报告天花板漏水，并与邻居王太太沟通。请先听/读对话，再完成8道听力题（单选、填空、判断正误/未提及）。之后学习语法：there be、可数与不可数名词、some/any、地点介词复习。语法讲解用中文，语法题8道为独立新句。最后完成口语和写作任务。所有题目和选项均为英文，解释为中文。答案依据原文，不要求推断。
transcript:
Li Wei: Good morning, Mrs. Wang. This is Li Wei from apartment 302. I have a problem. Water is coming from my ceiling.
Mrs. Wang: Oh no. Is the floor wet?
Li Wei: Yes, it is very wet. There is a big brown mark on the ceiling. There are some small drops on the table, too.
Mrs. Wang: I am sorry. Is the water near the window?
Li Wei: No, it is not near the window. It is above the kitchen table. There is a bucket under the leak now.
Mrs. Wang: Good. Do you have any towels?
Li Wei: Yes, I have two towels. But there is not any hot water in the bathroom. The water is cold.
Mrs. Wang: I see. I can call Mr. Chen, the plumber. He is at his shop now. He can come at three o’clock.
Li Wei: Three o’clock is fine. Is there a fee?
Mrs. Wang: No, there is no fee for you. The building pays for the repair. But please do not use the kitchen sink today.
Li Wei: OK. I will not use it. There are some boxes on the floor near the sink. I can move them.
Mrs. Wang: Thank you. Is your neighbor at home? Maybe he can help you.
Li Wei: No, he is not at home. He is at work. But I can move the boxes alone.
Mrs. Wang: Good. I will send you a message at two thirty. The plumber’s number is in the message.
Li Wei: Thank you, Mrs. Wang. See you at three.
Mrs. Wang: See you. I hope the leak stops soon.

grammar.title: there be；可数与不可数名词；some / any；地点介词复习
grammar.explanation: 本课新规则：用 there be 表示“某处有某物”。单数用 there is，复数用 there are。可数名词有单复数，如 a towel / two towels；不可数名词没有复数，如 water, hot water。肯定句用 some，否定句和疑问句常用 any。地点介词复习：in, on, under, near, above。注意：there be 的 be 动词看后面的名词，不看地点。
grammar.example: There is a big brown mark on the ceiling. There are some small drops on the table, too.

questions.prompt: There ___ a small window in my bedroom.
questions.explanation: a small window 是单数，所以用 there is。
questions.evidence: There is a big brown mark on the ceiling.

questions.prompt: There ___ two chairs near the table.
questions.explanation: two chairs 是复数，所以用 there are。
questions.evidence: There are some small drops on the table, too.

questions.prompt: I have ___ water in my bottle.
questions.explanation: 肯定句用 some；water 是不可数名词，不能用 a。
questions.evidence: There are some small drops on the table, too.

questions.prompt: Do you have ___ towels in the bathroom?
questions.explanation: 疑问句常用 any；towels 是复数可数名词。

questions.prompt: There is not ___ hot water in the kitchen.
questions.explanation: 否定句用 any；hot water 是不可数名词，不能用 many。
questions.evidence: But there is not any hot water in the bathroom.
There is a bucket under the leak now.

questions.prompt: There are ___ books on the desk.
questions.explanation: 肯定句用 some；books 是复数可数名词。
questions.evidence: There are some boxes on the floor near the sink.
